digest: Geopolitical tensions and attacks in the Middle East, including claims on a Saudi oil refinery, are sustaining a risk premium in oil markets.
Concerns and regulatory scrutiny around AI and tech stocks are growing amid chip case investigations and market downturns in Asia.
US intelligence warns of potential future tech outages as systems undergo upgrades.
Macroeconomic concerns persist as market participants watch inflation, retail earnings, and Federal Reserve policy discussions.
Retirement account balances like 401(k)s have experienced drops amid recent stock market swings.
